Name: Lady Spider
Description: May Reilly was a woman born during the Industrial Revolution in a different reality and made herself a steampunk spider suit with 18th century looking machinary. She started calling herself Lady Spider and tried to be a hero in her own reality. Lady Spider was created by Robbie Thompson and Denis Medri and first appeared in Spider-Verse Vol.1 issue 1 (2015).
